name: insecure-api
patch:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: insecure-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault

name: insecure-api
patch:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: insecure-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
